Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans, building sizes, ages, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment covering major systems and infrastructure; connects condition data to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Sections 4, 4.1-4.5).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections with methodology, including demographic trends and housing developments; detailed capacity utilization data by site and grade; links enrollment projections to facility actions and long-term planning including consolidation and new construction (Sections 2.3, 2.4, 5.2, Tables 3-5, 13).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle; detailed educational specifications linked to district mission and instructional priorities; comprehensive analysis of facilities supporting multiple programs including TK, CTE, special education, STEM, and collaborative learning; facility projects directly respond to educational needs (Sections 3.1-3.3, 4, 7).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes some reference to outdoor spaces such as playfields and green spaces at campuses; however, minimal detail or districtwide data on greening, shade, or environmental benefits; no comprehensive strategy for campus greening or outdoor learning (Sections 4.1, 4.2, 4.3).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate change impacts broadly in context of facility improvements and state mandates but lacks detailed climate risk assessment or specific mitigation strategies integrated into the plan (No detailed section on climate risk or mitigation).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions energy efficiency improvements such as LED lighting and HVAC upgrades; lacks comprehensive data on energy use or detailed strategies for energy resilience, electrification, or decarbonization; no explicit reference to state requirements like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals (Sections 4, 7).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, phased project prioritization, and multiple funding sources including state grants, developer fees, existing capital funds, and planned G.O. bonds; includes escalation assumptions and program reserves; aligns financial capacity with district priorities (Sections 6, 7, 8).
